items.source: A multi-value stream with a streaming media type (such as application/x-ndjson or text/event-stream) is adapted to, similar to using ResponseBodyEmitter or SseEmitter. Examples include Flux (Reactor) or Observable (RxJava). Applications can also return Flux<ServerSentEvent> or Observable<ServerSentEvent>.
items.translation: 具有流媒体类型（例如application/x-ndjson或text/event-stream）的多值流会适配为，类似于使用ResponseBodyEmitter或SseEmitter。示例包括Flux（Reactor）或Observable（RxJava）。应用程序还可以返回Flux<ServerSentEvent>或Observable<ServerSentEvent>。

items.source: DeferredResult provides onTimeout(Runnable) and onCompletion(Runnable) callbacks. See the javadoc of DeferredResult for more details. Callable can be substituted for WebAsyncTask that exposes additional methods for timeout and completion callbacks.
items.translation: DeferredResult 提供 onTimeout(Runnable) 和 onCompletion(Runnable) 回调。有关更多详细信息，请参阅 DeferredResult 的 javadoc。Callable 可以替代 WebAsyncTask，后者提供了用于超时和完成回调的额外方法。

items.source: When an emitter throws an IOException (for example, if the remote client went away), applications are not responsible for cleaning up the connection and should not invoke emitter.complete or emitter.completeWithError. Instead, the servlet container automatically initiates an AsyncListener error notification, in which Spring MVC makes a completeWithError call. This call, in turn, performs one final ASYNC dispatch to the application, during which Spring MVC invokes the configured exception resolvers and completes the request.
items.translation: 当emitter抛出IOException（例如，如果远程客户端断开连接）时，应用程序无需清理连接，也不应调用emitter.complete或emitter.completeWithError。相反，servlet 容器会自动发起一个AsyncListener错误通知，在此期间 Spring MVC 会执行一次completeWithError调用。该调用进而向应用程序执行最后一次ASYNC分发，期间 Spring MVC 会调用配置的异常解析器并完成请求。

items.source: If Micrometer Context Propagation is present on the classpath, when a controller method returns a reactive type such as Flux or Mono, all ThreadLocal values, for which there is a registered io.micrometer.ThreadLocalAccessor, are written to the Reactor Context as key-value pairs, using the key assigned by the ThreadLocalAccessor.
items.translation: 如果类路径上存在 Micrometer 上下文传播，当控制器方法返回诸如 Flux 或 Mono 等响应式类型时，所有已注册了 io.micrometer.ThreadLocalAccessor 的ThreadLocal值都会作为键值对写入 Reactor Context，使用的键由 ThreadLocalAccessor 分配。

items.source: DeferredResult, Callable, and WebAsyncTask return values in controller methods provide support for a single asynchronous return value.
items.translation: DeferredResult、Callable 和 WebAsyncTask 在控制器方法中返回的值，支持单个异步返回值。

items.source: WebAsyncTask is comparable to using Callable but allows customizing additional settings such a request timeout value, and the AsyncTaskExecutor to execute the java.util.concurrent.Callable with instead of the defaults set up globally for Spring MVC. Below is an example of using WebAsyncTask:
items.translation: WebAsyncTask 与使用Callable类似，但允许自定义其他设置，例如请求超时值，以及用于执行java.util.concurrent.Callable的AsyncTaskExecutor，而不是使用 Spring MVC 全局设置的默认值。下面是一个使用WebAsyncTask的示例：

items.source: HandlerInterceptor instances can be of type AsyncHandlerInterceptor, to receive the afterConcurrentHandlingStarted callback on the initial request that starts asynchronous processing (instead of postHandle and afterCompletion).
items.translation: HandlerInterceptor 实例可以是 AsyncHandlerInterceptor 类型，以便在启动异步处理的初始请求上接收 afterConcurrentHandlingStarted 回调（而不是 postHandle 和 afterCompletion）。

items.source: HandlerInterceptor implementations can also register a CallableProcessingInterceptor or a DeferredResultProcessingInterceptor, to integrate more deeply with the lifecycle of an asynchronous request (for example, to handle a timeout event). See AsyncHandlerInterceptor for more details.
items.translation: HandlerInterceptor 实现还可以注册 CallableProcessingInterceptor 或 DeferredResultProcessingInterceptor，以更深入地集成异步请求的生命周期（例如处理超时事件）。有关更多详细信息，请参阅AsyncHandlerInterceptor。

items.source: It is common to propagate context via java.lang.ThreadLocal. This works transparently for handling on the same thread, but requires additional work for asynchronous handling across multiple threads. The Micrometer Context Propagation library simplifies context propagation across threads, and across context mechanisms such as ThreadLocal values, Reactor context, GraphQL Java context, and others.
items.translation: 通常通过java.lang.ThreadLocal传播上下文。这种方式在处理同一线程时是透明的，但在跨多个线程进行异步处理时需要额外的工作。MicrometerContext Propagation库简化了跨线程以及跨上下文机制（如ThreadLocal值、Reactor context、GraphQL Java context等）的上下文传播。

items.source: In web.xml configuration, you can add <async-supported>true</async-supported> to the DispatcherServlet and to Filter declarations and add <dispatcher>ASYNC</dispatcher> to filter mappings.
items.translation: 在 web.xml 配置中，您可以在 DispatcherServlet 和 Filter 声明中添加 <async-supported>true</async-supported>，并在过滤器映射中添加 <dispatcher>ASYNC</dispatcher>。

items.source: Note that you can also set the default timeout value on a DeferredResult, a ResponseBodyEmitter, and an SseEmitter. For a Callable, you can use WebAsyncTask to provide a timeout value.
items.translation: 注意，您还可以在 DeferredResult、ResponseBodyEmitter 和 SseEmitter 上设置默认超时值。对于 Callable，您可以使用 WebAsyncTask 来提供超时值。

items.source: When you use a DeferredResult, you can choose whether to call setResult or setErrorResult with an exception. In both cases, Spring MVC dispatches the request back to the Servlet container to complete processing. It is then treated either as if the controller method returned the given value or as if it produced the given exception. The exception then goes through the regular exception handling mechanism (for example, invoking @ExceptionHandler methods).
items.translation: 使用 DeferredResult 时，您可以选择调用 setResult 或 setErrorResult（带有一个异常）。在这两种情况下，Spring MVC 都会将请求分派回 Servlet 容器以完成处理。随后，该请求将被视为控制器方法返回了给定值，或者产生了给定的异常。然后，该异常将通过常规的异常处理机制进行处理（例如，调用 @ExceptionHandler 方法）。

items.source: The Servlet API was originally built for making a single pass through the Filter-Servlet chain. Asynchronous request processing lets applications exit the Filter-Servlet chain but leave the response open for further processing. The Spring MVC asynchronous support is built around that mechanism. When a controller returns a DeferredResult, the Filter-Servlet chain is exited, and the Servlet container thread is released. Later, when the DeferredResult is set, an ASYNC dispatch (to the same URL) is made, during which the controller is mapped again but, rather than invoking it, the DeferredResult value is used (as if the controller returned it) to resume processing.
items.translation: Servlet API 最初是设计用于对 Filter-Servlet 链进行一次遍历。异步请求处理允许应用程序退出 Filter-Servlet 链，但保留响应以供进一步处理。Spring MVC 的异步支持正是基于该机制构建的。当控制器返回一个 DeferredResult 时，会退出 Filter-Servlet 链并释放 Servlet 容器线程。稍后，当设置 DeferredResult 时，会执行一次 ASYNC 分发（指向同一 URL），在此期间控制器会被重新映射，但不会调用它，而是使用 DeferredResult 的值（仿佛控制器返回了该值）来恢复处理。

items.source: SseEmitter (a subclass of ResponseBodyEmitter) provides support for Server-Sent Events, where events sent from the server are formatted according to the W3C SSE specification. To produce an SSE stream from a controller, return SseEmitter, as the following example shows:
items.translation: SseEmitter（ResponseBodyEmitter 的子类）提供了对服务器发送事件 (Server-Sent Events)的支持，其中从服务器发送的事件按照 W3C SSE 规范进行格式化。要从控制器生成 SSE 流，请返回 SseEmitter，如下例所示：

items.source: A single-value promise is adapted to, similar to using DeferredResult. Examples include CompletionStage (JDK), Mono (Reactor), and Single (RxJava).
items.translation: 单个值承诺的适配方式类似于使用DeferredResult。示例包括CompletionStage（JDK）、Mono（Reactor）和Single（RxJava）。

items.source: For streaming to the response, reactive back pressure is supported, but writes to the response are still blocking and are run on a separate thread through the configured AsyncTaskExecutor, to avoid blocking the upstream source such as a Flux returned from WebClient.
items.translation: 对于向响应进行流式传输，支持反应式背压，但写入响应仍然是阻塞操作，并通过配置的AsyncTaskExecutor在单独的线程上运行，以避免阻塞上游源（例如从WebClient返回的Flux）。

items.source: Filter and Servlet declarations have an asyncSupported flag that needs to be set to true to enable asynchronous request processing. In addition, Filter mappings should be declared to handle the ASYNC jakarta.servlet.DispatchType.
items.translation: Filter 和 Servlet 声明包含一个 asyncSupported 标志，需要将其设置为 true 以启用异步请求处理。此外，应声明 Filter 映射以处理 ASYNC jakarta.servlet.DispatchType。

items.source: Controllers can stream multiple values, including SSE and raw data.
items.translation: Controllers 可以 流式传输多个值，包括 SSE和原始数据。

items.source: The call to request.startAsync() returns AsyncContext, which you can use for further control over asynchronous processing. For example, it provides the dispatch method, which is similar to a forward from the Servlet API, except that it lets an application resume request processing on a Servlet container thread.
items.translation: 对 `request.startAsync()` 的调用返回一个 `AsyncContext`，您可以使用它来进一步控制异步处理。例如，它提供了 `dispatch` 方法，该方法类似于来自 Servlet API 的转发，但允许应用程序在 Servlet 容器线程上恢复请求处理。

items.source: Spring MVC calls request.startAsync() and submits the Callable to an AsyncTaskExecutor for processing in a separate thread.
items.translation: Spring MVC 调用request.startAsync()，并将Callable提交给AsyncTaskExecutor在单独的线程中进行处理。

items.source: You can use the ResponseBodyEmitter return value to produce a stream of objects, where each object is serialized with an HttpMessageConverter and written to the response, as the following example shows:
items.translation: 您可以使用 ResponseBodyEmitter 返回值来生成对象流，其中每个对象都由一个 HttpMessageConverter 进行序列化并写入响应，如下例所示：

items.source: Spring MVC supports use of reactive client libraries in a controller (also read Reactive Libraries in the WebFlux section). This includes the WebClient from spring-webflux and others, such as Spring Data reactive data repositories. In such scenarios, it is convenient to be able to return reactive types from the controller method.
items.translation: Spring MVC 支持在控制器中使用响应式客户端库（另请参阅 WebFlux 部分中的响应式库）。这包括来自spring-webflux的WebClient以及其他库，例如 Spring Data 响应式数据仓库。在这种情况下，能够从控制器方法返回响应式类型会非常方便。

items.source: AsyncTaskExecutor to use for blocking writes when streaming with Reactive Types and for executing Callable instances returned from controller methods. The one used by default is not suitable for production under load.
items.translation: 用于流式传输时进行阻塞写入的AsyncTaskExecutor，以及执行从控制器方法返回的Callable 实例。默认使用的执行器在负载下不适合生产环境。
一旦在 Servlet 容器中启用异步请求处理功能，控制器方法可以使用DeferredResult包装任何受支持的控制器方法返回值，如下例所示：

items.source: The return value can then be obtained by running the given task through the configured AsyncTaskExecutor.
items.translation: 返回的值可以通过运行给定任务通过已配置的AsyncTaskExecutor获得。

items.source: A ServletRequest can be put in asynchronous mode by calling request.startAsync(). The main effect of doing so is that the Servlet (as well as any filters) can exit, but the response remains open to let processing complete later.
items.translation: 通过调用request.startAsync()，可以将ServletRequest置于异步模式。这样做的主要效果是，Servlet（以及任何过滤器）可以退出，但响应保持打开状态，以便稍后完成处理。

items.source: The ServletRequest provides access to the current DispatcherType, which you can use to distinguish between processing the initial request, an asynchronous dispatch, a forward, and other dispatcher types.
items.translation: ServletRequest 提供对当前 DispatcherType 的访问，您可以使用它来区分处理初始请求、异步分发、转发以及其他分发器类型。

items.source: The DispatcherServlet is invoked again, and processing resumes with the asynchronously produced return value from the Callable.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 再次被调用，处理流程使用从 Callable 异步生成的返回值继续。

items.source: When you use Callable, similar processing logic occurs, the main difference being that the result is returned from the Callable or an exception is raised by it.
items.translation: 使用Callable时，处理逻辑类似，主要区别在于结果由Callable返回或由其抛出异常。

items.source: Another fundamental difference is that Spring MVC does not support asynchronous or reactive types in controller method arguments (for example, @RequestBody, @RequestPart, and others), nor does it have any explicit support for asynchronous and reactive types as model attributes. Spring WebFlux does support all that.
items.translation: 另一个根本区别在于，Spring MVC 不支持控制器方法参数中的异步或响应式类型（例如 @RequestBody、@RequestPart 等），也不支持将异步和响应式类型作为模型属性。Spring WebFlux 则支持所有这些功能。

items.source: You can use DeferredResult and Callable for a single asynchronous return value. What if you want to produce multiple asynchronous values and have those written to the response? This section describes how to do so.
items.translation: 您可以使用DeferredResult和Callable来生成单个异步返回值。如果您想要生成多个异步值并将它们写入响应中，该怎么办？本节将介绍如何实现这一点。

items.source: You can also use ResponseBodyEmitter as the body in a ResponseEntity, letting you customize the status and headers of the response.
items.translation: 您也可以使用 ResponseBodyEmitter 作为 ResponseEntity 中的主体，从而自定义响应的状态和标头。

items.source: While SSE is the main option for streaming into browsers, note that Internet Explorer does not support Server-Sent Events. Consider using Spring’s WebSocket messaging with SockJS fallback transports (including SSE) that target a wide range of browsers.
items.translation: 虽然 SSE 是向浏览器流式传输的主要选项，但请注意 Internet Explorer 不支持服务器发送事件。建议使用 Spring 的WebSocket 消息传递配合支持多种浏览器（包括 SSE）的SockJS 回退传输方式。
有时，跳过消息转换并直接流式传输到响应OutputStream（例如用于文件下载）会很有用。您可以使用StreamingResponseBody返回类型来实现此功能，如下例所示：

items.source: You can use StreamingResponseBody as the body in a ResponseEntity to customize the status and headers of the response.
items.translation: 您可以使用StreamingResponseBody作为ResponseEntity中的主体，以自定义响应的状态和标头。

items.source: A multi-value stream with any other media type (such as application/json) is adapted to, similar to using DeferredResult<List<?>>.
items.translation: 具有任何其他媒体类型（例如application/json）的多值流会适配为，类似于使用DeferredResult<List<?>>。

items.source: The Servlet API does not provide any notification when a remote client goes away. Therefore, while streaming to the response, whether through SseEmitter or reactive types, it is important to send data periodically, since the write fails if the client has disconnected. The send could take the form of an empty (comment-only) SSE event or any other data that the other side would have to interpret as a heartbeat and ignore.
items.translation: Servlet API 不会在远程客户端断开时提供任何通知。因此，在使用 SseEmitter 或 reactive types 向响应流式传输数据时，定期发送数据非常重要，因为如果客户端已断开连接，写入操作将会失败。发送的数据可以是一个空的（仅包含注释）SSE 事件，或者是任何其他需要对方将其解释为心跳并忽略的数据。

items.source: Alternatively, consider using web messaging solutions (such as STOMP over WebSocket or WebSocket with SockJS) that have a built-in heartbeat mechanism.
items.translation: 或者，考虑使用具有内置心跳机制的 Web 消息解决方案（例如WebSocket 上的 STOMP或带有的 WebSocket）。

items.source: Java configuration: Use the configureAsyncSupport callback on WebMvcConfigurer.
items.translation: Java 配置：在 WebMvcConfigurer 上使用 configureAsyncSupport 回调。

items.source: XML namespace: Use the <async-support> element under <mvc:annotation-driven>.
items.translation: XML 命名空间：在 `` 下使用 `<async-support>` 元素。

items.source: From a programming model perspective, both Spring MVC and Spring WebFlux support asynchronous and Reactive Types as return values in controller methods. Spring MVC even supports streaming, including reactive back pressure. However, individual writes to the response remain blocking (and are performed on a separate thread), unlike WebFlux, which relies on non-blocking I/O and does not need an extra thread for each write.
items.translation: 从编程模型的角度来看，Spring MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 都支持将异步和响应式类型作为控制器方法的返回值。Spring MVC 甚至支持流式传输，包括响应式背压。然而，对响应的单个写入操作仍然是阻塞的（并在单独的线程上执行），这与 WebFlux 不同，WebFlux 依赖于非阻塞 I/O，因此不需要为每个写入操作分配额外的线程。

items.source: Finally, from a configuration perspective the asynchronous request processing feature must be enabled at the Servlet container level.
items.translation: 最后，从配置角度来看，必须在 Servlet 容器级别启用异步请求处理功能。

items.source: See also previous section for notes on exception handling.
